description: Default capability for the app's own windows: core IPC and the libraries screen's commands. The main window shows that screen (launcher-dist/index.html) until a library opens, and again when one closes; its every button is an `invoke` of one of main.rs's `launcher_*` commands. Its top bar is the title bar (main.rs `under_title_bar`), so it may also move and zoom the window. It is a LOCAL page, so unlike the other capability files this needs no `remote` block — and with none, none of these commands reaches a library's page, which is served from the backend's localhost URL. build.rs declares the app's commands, so each is granted by name.
